brief:
Hamas denounced statements by Nikolai Miladnov, representative of the UN Security Council, who said Gaza remains "far from reconstruction," Shehab Wire reported. The movement characterized his remarks as an abdication of his appointed role within the so-called Peace Council framework.

Hamas demanded that Israeli occupation forces halt violations as a precondition for any rebuilding efforts in the territory. The group tied reconstruction progress directly to a cessation of military operations and compliance with ceasefire terms, rejecting what it framed as premature focus on recovery while fighting continued.
